broadcasts.message: normalize.js unchanged and verified. All modules consistent. No integration issues. Ready for final round.

tokenizer.js remains unchanged and correct. It uses injected normalize(text), then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes. Tokens are in input order, no stopwords, negation preserved. Ready for final integration.

pipeline.js remains stable and correct. It calls injected tokenize(text), returns the exact required object, handles prototype names via null-prototype frequencies, and preserves first-seen unique order. No changes needed. Ready for final round.
